result.reason: The operative redline fully reaches the fallback: it creates a mutual 12-month-fees cap and mutually carves out indemnification, confidentiality breaches, gross negligence, and willful misconduct. It does not reach the preferred position because it omits the USD 1,000,000 floor, indirect-damages wording, data protection, security, fraud, and IP-infringement carve-outs, and the payment-obligations clarification. The changes are limited to the cap basis and required fallback carve-outs, while retaining the existing mutual damages exclusion. Drafting quality is reduced by the stray duplicate period and the less precise phrasing “liability for either Party” rather than “liability of either Party.”
